description: Points d'arrêts de bus - CA Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines is a dataset listed in Datasqy open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines. Cette donnée présente les points d'arrêt des lignes de bus. Elle indique notamment le niveau de mise à la norme PMR Informations générales de la classe d'entité Origine ou Source: SQY Date de construction: 2018 Actualité: Septembre 2023 Précision: Système de référence: RGF93 - CC49 (EPSG 3949) Contact: opendata@sqy.fr Exhaustivité géographique: SQY et ses environs. Coverage: Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are transport en commun, Ligne de bus, arrêt de bus, déplacements, accessibilité. The portal shows 1,011 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-08-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-sqy-fr-portal.
